nom: BLUME Milky Fade Spot and Scar Serum

segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers with sensitive, allergy-prone, or rosacea-affected skin report the serum did not irritate or break them out, though a few sensitive-skin reviewers experienced burning, stinging, or breakouts.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe the texture as lightweight and non-heavy, good for wearing under makeup, with one noting it evened her complexion.
segments.oily: One reviewer notes the serum also helped control her oiliness alongside fading scars.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry-tending skin found it hydrating without greasy residue and left skin feeling soft rather than dried out.

concerns.spots: The great majority of reviewers report visible fading of dark spots and hyperpigmentation, often within one to four weeks; a couple report no noticeable difference after weeks of use.
concerns.aging: One reviewer used it on age spots on her hands and arms and reports they disappeared within one to two weeks without irritation.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness and calmer skin, including one with rosacea who had no irritation; this is consistently described as positive with no dissent noted.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe the serum as drying, causing peeling, stinging, or chemical-burn-like scabbing when overused, while others report no dryness at all and even find it hydrating.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer mentions the serum helped control her oiliness alongside its scar-fading effect; not widely discussed elsewhere.
concerns.dehydration: Some reviewers highlight the formula as hydrating and non-greasy, while a smaller number report dryness or peeling with regular use.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky feel before absorption

extraits.titre: It works but a little too well
extraits.texte: I started using this about two weeks ago just to see if there would be any difference in my dark marks. Good news is, my spots are fading. Bad news is, this stuff is kind of burning my face? The instructions say to use 1-2 pumps daily after cleansing and use moisturizer and spf. If you have sensitive skin, maybe only do this once or twice a week at night and pump your face with moisturizer afterwards. It dries you out and makes your face peel, and sometimes stings a little. Like yes, my acne spots are going away, but now I have chemical burn scabbing on my cheeks and chin. Use it carefully and it could be a good experience, but be warned, it's potent stuff! DO NOT SKIP MOISTURIZER!

I bought this because I have age spots on my arms and hands, plus I had a coupon. My skin is extremely sensitive so I was a bit wary. Lo and behold, Blume Milky Fade really did disappear my age spots without irritation. It's a bit spendy, but you don't have to use a lot. I applied it every other day and within a week or two (depending on how dark the pigmentation of the spot is) the age spots were no more.

This is one of my holy grail products. I seriously hope Blume never discontinues this. I have struggled with acne in my 30s, and have tried everything - oral medications, creams, etc, without success. My face would end up burnt, red, and irritated. I tried Blume on a whim several years ago and never looked back. I absolutely love this product. It took a few months to really work (my skin was bad). It fades dark spots left behind by acne, and doesn't leave a residue on your face. I use this twice a day with the meltdown oil, and together, they have been a game changer for my skin. If you're on the fence, I highly highly recommend!

Love this product! I use it right before my moisturizer and sunscreen. Have visibly noticed less scarring and red marks on my face. A little bit of the serum goes a long way. Suitable for sensitive South Asian skin

I have been using this serum for a week and here are my thoughts. First of all, I love the packaging. This serum comes in a heavy purple bottle that feels luxurious. I love that the serum dispenser is a pump. It's a milky coloured serum that's lightly fragrant. Nothing too strong or too disturbing. It easily blends into the skin and is quickly absorbed. It layers beautifully with my other skincare products. I have rosacea and I'm always hesitant to try products containing vitamin C since it can be irritating. Thankfully, this serum did not irritate my skin and did not break me out. I love that this serum contains centella asiatica, an amazing calming ingredient for rosacea. I don't know which ingredient is responsible for this, but from the first use, I have noticed a glow on my face. My relatives also noticed and complimented my skin. This serum claims to fade scars and I'm really hoping it will help fade my post-acne scarring. I haven't noticed a drastic change yet, but my skin does look a bit smoother. I think I just found a new favourite skincare product. I will continue to use this serum regularly and I'm excited to see more results.

I enjoyed how it made my skin feel, moisturized and calmed, but it made me break out. After 2 weeks of use alongside the meltdown cleanser and oil, I noticed my hormonal acne settling down but also new breakouts in unusual spots. I had an inkling it was the milky fade and took it out of the mix. The breakouts subsided. Just in case, I tried it again and the breakouts restarted. So I can confidently say the milky fade did not work for me. I love The rest of the hormonal acne kit though!

This product has not only faded newer/older acne scars, but has kept my complexion bright and even. I will be honest in saying that it doesn't make deeper set scars disappear, but they do soften some in texture. It also may take some time for more stubborn scars. Definitely can't live without Milky Fade!
